title: A KAN-based Non-linear Factorization for Embedding Layer Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.29424v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Among existing embedding compression approaches, low-rank factorization provides a simple and mathematically principled solution by approximating the embedding matrix with a reduced-rank decomposition. However, its practical effectiveness is often limited, as the resulting linear bottleneck constrains representational capacity. To overcome these limitations, we propose an enhanced factorization scheme that increases expressive power by introducing learnable non-linear projections within the compressed embedding layer. Our method is inspired by the Kolmogorov Arnold Networks (KAN) paradigm, which replaces fixed linear transformations with learnable univariate functions. Despite promising results in other domains, applications of KANs in NLP remain scarce and have so far been largely limited to final or task specific layers, rather than core representational components such as embedding layers. translated_abstract: 在现有的嵌入压缩方法中，低秩分解通过使用降秩分解来近似嵌入矩阵，提供了一种简单且具有数学原理依据的解决方案。然而，其实际效果往往有限，因为由此产生的线性瓶颈限制了表示能力。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一种增强的分解方案，通过在压缩的嵌入层中引入可学习的非线性投影来提高表达能力。我们的方法受到Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）范式的启发，该范式用可学习的单变量函数替代固定的线性变换。尽管KAN在其他领域取得了令人瞩目的成果，但其在自然语言处理（NLP）中的应用仍然稀缺，且迄今为止主要局限于最终层或任务特定层，而非嵌入层等核心表示组件。我们通过将所提出的方法集成……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的非线性分解方法，通过在压缩嵌入层中引入可学习的非线性投影，突破传统低秩分解的线性瓶颈，提升嵌入层压缩后的表示能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a KAN-based non-linear factorization scheme that introduces learnable non-linear projections within the compressed embedding layer, overcoming the linear bottleneck of low-rank factorization to enhance representational capacity in embedding compression.
